selection_policy.grove: Upbeat, fun, happy, hopeful, loving and new beginnings. No acid/techno; avoid chart-pop/top-five-hit character, sad music and negative lyrics.
selection_policy.hollow: High energy, bouncy, hard, dark and fast techno/acid/rave, with limited house overlap and a reduced DnB lane.
selection_policy.separation: Distinct spaces and moods. Shared house vocabulary is allowed; no duplicate recordings across rooms.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Catalog valence does not determine lyric meaning. Source lyric themes and editorial sound hypotheses remain distinct; complete exact-edit lyrics/listening are not certified.

selection_method: Latest explicit room brief takes precedence over historical boundary tests. Use completed host votes, private saved-library candidates where suitable, and fresh discovery; no automatic room approval from Spotify Likes.

audit.listening_status: Catalog identity and metadata verified; no full audio audition, acoustic identity proof or rendered mix.

privacy_note: Full saved-library exports, per-recording saved membership/timestamps, OAuth data, review backups and lyric caches stay ignored. Portable candidates contain no personal saved-state flags or lyric transcripts.
